West Pakistan (Servants Of Local Councils) Traveling Allowances Rules
1962
West
Pakistan (Servants Of Local
Councils) Traveling Allowances Rules
1962
[Gazette of West
Pakistan,
Extraordinary, 18th October 1962]
No. SOI/BD/-3.4/62. In exercise of the powers conferred on him by
Article 89 of the Basic Democracies Order, 1959 (P. O. 18 of 19 9),
herein-after referred to as the Order, read with Article 47 and entry 13 of the
Sixth Schedule thereto, the Governor of West Pakistan is pleased to make the
following rules, namely :
1. Short
title, commencement and application. (1) These Rules may be called the West Pakistan (Servants of Local Councils) Travelling
Allowances Rules, 1962.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Application
of the West Pakistan Traveling Allowances Rules. The provisions of
the West Pakistan Traveling Allowances Rules shall, so far as may be, apply to
the servants of Local Councils and for that purpose the said Rules shall be deemed
to have been made under the Order, and in the said Rules
(a) any
reference to a Government servant shall be deemed to be a reference to servant
of a Local Council ; and
(b) any reference
to the competent authority shall be deemed to be a reference to the Controlling
Authority under the Order.
